title: E2E Specification Compiler
description: Compiles E2E test specifications. Enforces: user flows cover multiple routes (not single-page tests), at least one critical path declared, baseUrl from environment variable, no hardcoded credentials in flows, page objects use accessible selectors (not CSS class/ID), retries only in CI (local retries hide flaky tests), failure artifacts configured.

error_codes.QA020: e2e-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: framework, baseUrl, userFlows[]
error_codes.QA021: No user flow marked criticalPath: true — cannot determine pre-deploy gate
error_codes.QA022: User flow covers only one route — single-route flows are component tests, not E2E
error_codes.QA023: baseUrl contains hardcoded localhost or IP — must use environment variable ${E2E_BASE_URL}
error_codes.QA024: User flow spec contains password or token as literal value — hardcoded credentials detected
error_codes.QA025: retries.local > 0 — local retries hide flaky tests; retries must be CI-only
error_codes.QA026: Page object file uses CSS class selector (.class) or ID selector (#id) — use getByRole/getByLabel
error_codes.QA027: failureArtifacts.screenshot not enabled — CI cannot diagnose failures without screenshots
